test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

Vikram was a fashion designer __who made clothes__ out of sustainable materials.
solution:
The correct answer is: **No improvement is required**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is written in the simple past tense.
 
• When we see the sentence we notice that it is written as "*Vikram was__ a fashion designer.*"
 
• So, the verb "**made**" is also written in the 3rd form which denotes the past tense.
 
• **Clothes **are garments or pieces of clothing, like shirts and pants, so it is a plural subject.
 
• "__Sustainable materials__" is also mentioned in the sentence which is also plural.
 
• From here it is clear that the sentence is both grammatically and conceptually correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**, i. e "**No improvement required**."
